ACTION.TITLE: Actions
ACTION.ASSOCIATION_TARGET_HINT: This card will go to the player chosen below
ACTION.ROBBED_STEAL: Someone stole a card from you!
ACTION.ROBBED_WAR: You were attacked! 2 cards were taken from you.
ACTION.SHOP_HINT: Produce a complete set to score points!

WHO_HAVE_CARD.LABEL: Who has this family?
WHO_HAVE_CARD.DESC: Find out who holds a card from a family you're missing. Costs 1 token.
WHO_HAVE_CARD.HINT: Select a card — you'll find out who holds a card of the same family.
WHO_HAVE_CARD.RESULT_PLAYER: {{name}} has a card of this family.
WHO_HAVE_CARD.RESULT_DECK: A card of this family is in the deck.
WHO_HAVE_CARD.RESULT_UNKNOWN: No one holds a card of this family right now.

GIVE.LABEL: Give a card
GIVE.DESC: Give one of your cards to a player of your choice.

STEAL.LABEL: Steal a card
STEAL.DESC: Take a card from another player. They will be notified.

SILENT_STEAL.LABEL: Silent steal
SILENT_STEAL.DESC: Take a card without the other player being notified.

ASSOCIATION.LABEL: Association
ASSOCIATION.DESC: Give 2 of your cards to 2 players of your choice (1 each).

WAR.LABEL: War
WAR.DESC: Steal 2 random cards from each of 2 players.

ONG.LABEL: ONG
ONG.DESC: Give 4 of your cards to the 2 poorest players (2 each).
